## 1. What CI/CD platform did you test with?

Example: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, local script.

## 2. What SAST tool/output did you use?

Example: Semgrep JSON, sample dataset, custom output converter.

## 3. Did Heimdall run successfully?

Yes/no, and what command or workflow did you run?

## 4. Did the TP / FP / Needs Review decision make sense?

What seemed accurate or inaccurate?

## 5. What part was confusing?

Docs, config, reports, policy behavior, CLI output, workflow setup, or something else?

## 6. Would this reduce triage workload?

Why or why not?

## 7. What feature is missing before real adoption?

What would make this more useful in your workflow?

## Safety Note

Do not include real secrets, private source code, production URLs, or vulnerability details from systems you do not own.
